conditions.description: Participation is not restricted at topic level. The eligibility and admissibility conditions are those described in General Annex B, with two topic-level exceptions (JRC participation and mandatory use of Copernicus/Galileo/EGNOS).

The Joint Research Centre (JRC) may participate as a member of the selected consortium as a beneficiary with zero funding, or as an associated partner. The JRC does not participate in the preparation and submission of the proposal.

If the project uses satellite-based Earth observation, positioning, navigation or related timing data and services, beneficiaries must use Copernicus and/or Galileo/EGNOS. Other data and services may additionally be used. This is an eligibility condition, not a preference.

The Commission estimates that an EU contribution of around EUR 5.00 million would allow the outcomes to be addressed appropriately, though proposals requesting different amounts may be submitted and selected. The total indicative topic budget is EUR 10.00 million, with around 2 projects expected to be funded.
